caveats: 3309 of 3600 region cells were sea cells (finite SST on all 92 target days); land cells are 0 in the mask. Per-cell MHW = run of >=5 consecutive hot days (SST >= smoothed doy threshold, 90th pct, hazen, 121-value pool), then MHWs separated by 1-2 non-hot days joined; no cell met the 5-day duration, so there are no regional events. The 2013 summer was warm vs the 1992-2002 climatology (up to ~+2.7 K) but exceeded the 90th-percentile threshold only on isolated days (max per-cell hot run length 4). baseline_analysed spans all days whose SST values were used, i.e. the 1992-2002 baseline plus the +-5-day window extensions 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05. Thresholds/climatology computed in float64; day 60 set to mean of days 59/61 then 31-day circular moving mean.
